ABOUT THIS PILOT

A little help
before you plant.

We compare past rain and warmth with broad crop guides, then show the three highest climate-fit matches. Southern options include rubber, oil palm, and durian.

Each area has 30 years of NASA POWER weather history. The records describe a broad area, not your exact field.

This is not a reliable forecast for 2027. Ask a local farm adviser about soil, drainage, seeds, and water before planting.
